import pytest
from jinja2 import Environment
import asyncio

@pytest.fixture
def env_async():
    env = Environment(enable_async=True)
    env.filters.update({'add_two': lambda x, y: [i + y for i in x]})
    return env

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_custom_filter_with_slice_async_true(env_async):
    template = env_async.from_string("{% for item in (a.b|add_two(5))[:1] %}{{ item }}{% endfor %}")
    data = {"a": {"b": [1, 2, 3]}}
    result = await template.render_async(data)
    assert result == "6"

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_custom_filter_with_slice_async_true_multiple_items(env_async):
    template = env_async.from_string("{% for item in (a.b|add_two(5))[:2] %}{{ item }}{% endfor %}")
    data = {"a": {"b": [1, 2, 3]}}
    result = await template.render_async(data)
    assert result == "67"

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_custom_filter_with_slice_async_true_empty_slice(env_async):
    template = env_async.from_string("{% for item in (a.b|add_two(5))[:0] %}{{ item }}{% endfor %}")
    data = {"a": {"b": [1, 2, 3]}}
    result = await template.render_async(data)
    assert result == ""
